description: Count KRS companies matching given filters. Returns a single number — no company list. Does not count JDG in this tool (full CEIDG is in Compabase; listing is RODO-gated). Sparse or zero counts in JDG-dominated PKDs include a `hint`.

all_pkd.description: Match any PKD code in the company's activity list (not just primary).

estimated_value_max.description: Maximum Ohlson estimated equity value in PLN.

estimated_value_min.description: Minimum Ohlson estimated equity value in PLN.

has_email.description: true = only companies with email on record. Omit otherwise.

has_website.description: true = only companies with website on record. Omit otherwise.

is_active.description: true = active only, false = closed only. Omit for all.

krs.description: KRS number of the company in the Polish National Court Register (10 digits).

name.description: Company name, used when the KRS or NIP is not known.

nip.description: Polish company tax number (NIP) of the business, 10 digits.

pkd.description: Primary PKD code prefix, e.g. '46.90.Z' or '46'.

registration_date_min.description: Earliest KRS registration date, YYYY-MM-DD (inclusive). For newly registered companies use today's date for both registration_date_min and registration_date_max.

year.description: Filter to companies whose latest financial_period_to falls within this calendar year. Use only for sector/ranking browse — omit when looking up a company by name, KRS, or NIP.

name: count_companies
title: Count Polish Companies
